title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Bootstrapped…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WP Recipe Maker plugin versions up to 10.9.2. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
